# Third-party files in this folder

Copied unchanged from source-lightbox's `static/` (2026-11-04), for the study gallery's viewer
and sortable tables. Both are MIT-licensed; their notices are kept here as the licence asks.

| File | Project | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `glightbox.min.js`, `glightbox.min.css` | GLightbox, https://github.com/biati-digital/glightbox | 3.3.0 | MIT; copyright Biati Digital (the project's LICENSE.md; the minified file carries no header) |
| `tablesort.min.js` | Tablesort, http://tristen.ca/tablesort/demo/ | 5.2.1 | MIT; its header: "Copyright (c) 2021 ; Licensed MIT" |
